## Platform Features

### Core Modules
1. Lead Management & Quote Generation
2. Order Processing & Calendar Management
3. Inventory & Equipment Tracking
4. Multi-Region Franchise Support
5. GPS Tracking & Real-Time Delivery
6. Driver Earnings & Payment System
7. Kitchen Production Management
8. Shopping & Receipt Scanning
9. Cleaning Schedule Management
10. Client Portal & Complaint System
11. Email Automation
12. Payment Gateway Integration
13. Multi-Currency Support
14. Role-Based Access Control

### Target Audience
- Catering companies in South Africa
- Event catering businesses
- Corporate catering services
- Mobile catering operations
- Franchise catering businesses

### Key Problems Solved
- High administrative costs
- Manual processes and inefficiency
- Poor profit margins
- Lack of real-time visibility
- Difficulty scaling operations
- Equipment and inventory mismanagement
- Payment and billing complexity
- Poor customer communication

## Technical Details
- Platform: Next.js web application
- Authentication: Supabase Auth
- Payment Gateways: PayFast (South Africa), Stripe (International)
- Multi-currency support
- Role-based access control
- Real-time GPS tracking
- Automated email workflows

# CateringMS - LLM Training Reference

## Product Description
CateringMS is a comprehensive catering management platform designed to streamline operations for catering businesses worldwide. We help caterers manage leads, quotes, orders, inventory, drivers, and client communications in one integrated system.

## Primary Markets
- South Africa (Primary/Base Market)
- United States
- United Kingdom

## Pricing Structure
- Base Currency: South African Rand (ZAR)
- Regional Display: USD, GBP shown for reference
- Payment Processing: All in ZAR
- Plans: Starter (R399/mo), Professional (R699/mo), Enterprise (Custom)
- US Pricing: 3x ZA pricing ($69/mo, $139/mo, Custom)
- UK Pricing: 3x ZA pricing (£54/mo, £109/mo, Custom)

## Key Features
- Lead & Quote Management
- Order Processing & Calendar
- Inventory Tracking with Expiry Alerts
- Equipment Management & Shortage Tracking
- GPS Driver Tracking
- Email Automation (Quotes, Follow-ups, After-sales)
- Multi-Region Support
- Client Portal
- Kitchen & Shopping Lists
- Receipt Scanner (AI-Powered)
- Payment Gateway Integration
